shared_elements: repeated motifs organised in parallel bands or registers
a narrow vertical pillar/pilaster element adjoining a broader surface
justification: Both surfaces bear shallow schematic relief marks laid out in repeated parallel bands, which is about as generic a correspondence as decorated stone can offer. A depicts only abstract chevron/herringbone rows running down a narrow upright, while B depicts dense horizontal registers of many small distinct pictorial signs plus a discrete figural/object motif in relief — different repertoires and different layouts.
